title: The Heart is like if a really good episode of the Pitt went to EDC
transcript: There's a lot of really exciting musical theatre happening off Broadway right now. The heart is the one to make me cry the most. I cannot recommend this enough. I've been able to follow the journey of the heart from LA Jolla Playhouse to now off Broadway, and I know for a fact that this is going to be on Broadway someday because it really has shaped up nicely and is such a cohesive and exhilarating piece of theatre. This is a 90 minute quick EDM Musical that follows the journey of a heart transplant over a 24 hour period. The EDM music is not only incredibly original in the musical theatre sphere, but it also has this, like, really incredible pulsating beat that feels like you are rushing through a hospital. And yet it is. It is still able to slow down and find these really touching and beautiful soft moments. There are still a couple moments, specifically near the end of the musical, that I feel just need a little more tweaking. But when I tell you this is is one of the strongest new musicals currently playing off Broadway, I. I cannot stress that enough. If you have space to put this into your schedule, do it. Do it. The heart has this incredible ensemble cast including Drew Gehling, who just got cast in Paddington. Heidi Blickenstaff, Nick T. Daley is absolutely fantastic. The list could go on. I think the. The ensemble That they've assembled here at the heart is incredible. And they swapped through all of these different characters. Similar to come From away, but music and vibe wise, of course, the show could not be more different. And the heart does such a great way of humanizing this procedure, from the patients at both ends of a transplant to the doctors and medical professionals that sacrifice so much in order to be able to save lives on the daily. I think the heart does a great job of grappling with all of the different characters that are present in the show. And the score is really, really good. And if if you don't love EDM, I think it does a great job of mixing EDM Styles. There's still diversity to the songs in the score. I really love the song. I really, really, really want a cast album of this. I cannot recommend it enough. As far as tickets go, I did get mine as a hip ticket. All round about shows offer 30 dollar tickets if you are under the age of forty. Those usually sell out. I don't know if they have any left. They also offer an in person rush for $20, which is how I saw it the first time I went to go see the heart. This is already my second for the off Broadway production. I will probably they be back one more time before it closes. That is how Much. I love the show. And, uh, I think. I think you all should go see it.
